title: Returning Buyer Lender Days on an Activated Homesite Reservation Hold
content:
A Homesite Reservation buyer who has bought from Calloway before receives activation lender bonus days on the activated hold, set by how the earlier home was financed. The record read is the buyer's earlier Home Purchase Agreement with status closed and its financing type.

**Clause.** The activation lender bonus is **2** days for a buyer whose earlier Calloway Home Purchase Agreement stands closed with financing type Calloway Home Mortgage, **1** day for a buyer whose earlier Calloway Home Purchase Agreement stands closed with financing type outside lender or cash, and zero for a buyer with no closed Calloway Home Purchase Agreement.

## Record cases (hypothetical buyers)

| Buyer's Home Purchase Agreement records | Activation lender bonus |
|---|---|
| one agreement, status closed, financing type Calloway Home Mortgage | 2 days |
| one agreement, status closed, financing type outside lender | 1 day |
| one agreement, status closed, financing type cash | 1 day |
| one agreement, status under construction, financing type Calloway Home Mortgage | zero, no closed agreement |
| no Home Purchase Agreement | zero |

## Basis note

Only an agreement that stands closed counts. An agreement still under construction, closing scheduled, cancelled or terminated is not a closed Calloway purchase agreement, whatever its financing type.
